# Troubleshooting and safety {#sec-troubleshooting}

## Common situations

| Observation | Action |
| --- | --- |
| **Unsupported modality** | The DICOM is recognized but is not supported ophthalmic fundus input. Do not send it to the models. |
| **AI analysis is not available** | Continue image review and human decisions when appropriate. Ask the operator to check Model API readiness and the workstation connection. |
| **No PRISM overlays** | Check **Show AI suggestions**, the lesion filter, and whether a result is available. An empty result does not prove lesion absence. |
| **Draft save failed** | Keep the page open, correct the reviewer or connectivity issue, and choose **Save draft** again. |
| **Case is not DR-ready** | Check image admission, final grade, reviewer, timestamp, and grade provenance. |
| **Case is not Lesion-ready** | Check the active annotation set and whether its hash changed after **Confirm Annotation**. |
| **CVAT is unavailable** | Continue local review where possible. Retry the optional integration after the configured URL, project, credentials, and network are available. |

## What the workstation records

The workstation records source and analysis identity, patient and eye context, image admission state, clinician decisions, reviewer names, timestamps, annotation revisions, confirmation hashes, inference metadata, model provenance, and dataset readiness. The source image remains immutable.

## Safety and privacy

::: {.callout-warning title="WARNING - clinical use"}
This is a research and clinical-support proof of concept. Model output is assistive evidence. Human review remains authoritative. The product does not establish autonomous diagnosis, referral, treatment, or disease truth.
:::

::: {.callout-caution title="CAUTION - data handling"}
Use only approved public, synthetic, or authorized clinical data. Do not put PHI, private DICOM headers, tokens, passwords, CVAT credentials, model weights, or runtime databases in screenshots, examples, exports, or source control.
:::

## Glossary

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| AI suggestion | A model output shown to support inspection. |
| DR-ready | The case satisfies the existing dataset rules for the DR-grade task. |
| Lesion-ready | The case satisfies the existing dataset rules for lesion annotations. |
| Model score | A value returned by a model. It is not automatically a calibrated probability. |
| Original AI evidence | The class, score, geometry, identity, model, and provenance returned by inference before human edits. |
| Reviewer preference | A browser-local default name for new or unattributed review forms. It is not authentication. |
